description: This file defines the TokenProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods for creating, chaining, caching, and managing token providers used to authenticate with AWS services, including support for SSO tokens and cache management.

classes.name: TokenProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to create, chain, and cache AWS token providers, including support for default, static, chained, and cached tokens, as well as SSO token retrieval.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default token provider that checks for cached SSO tokens, supporting environment profile configuration.

methods.name: fromToken
methods.description: Creates a token provider function from a static token.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates an aggregate token provider that invokes provided providers sequentially until a token is returned.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a token provider to cache the token and refresh it when expired.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a token provider and caches the token in an Aws\CacheInterface instance.

methods.name: loadDefaultProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves profile configurations from the ~/.aws/config ini file.

methods.name: sso
methods.description: Returns a token provider for SSO tokens based on a specified profile and configuration.
